decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of counter spells, card draw, and efficient removal to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also includes key artifact cards like Time Vault and various Mox cards to generate mana advantage. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds extra value by allowing for the recursion of important cards from the graveyard. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and maintain a strong board presence through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly through artifacts like Mishra's Workshop and Grim Monolith, then utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome to draw a lot of cards and gain a significant advantage. The goal is to assemble the Time Vault and Voltaic Key combo to take extra turns and win the game. The deck also has disruption in the form of Force of Will and Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opposing strategies. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful board state through combo plays and efficient mana generation.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Coveted Jewel and use it to generate mana and draw cards, setting up for a win condition or disrupting the opponent's game plan. It utilizes powerful artifact ramp like Mishra's Workshop and Grim Monolith, along with control elements like Force of Will and Trinisphere to protect the combo and ensure its success. The deck also includes tutoring effects like Tinker and Karn, the Great Creator to find key pieces of the combo efficiently. Overall, the strategy revolves around leveraging artifacts and the Coveted Jewel to create a powerful advantage.

The deck focuses on using powerful control spells and disruptive interactions to outmaneuver and outlast the opponent. It utilizes a mix of countermagic, card draw, and disruption effects alongside powerful artifacts like Moxen and Ancestral Recall to maintain control of the game. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value and recursion options. By disrupting the opponent's game plan and controlling the pace of the game, the deck aims to grind out incremental advantages and secure a win through attrition.

This deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells and efficient creatures to apply early pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage through spells like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value by consistently bringing back small creatures from the graveyard. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's aggressive game plan while also providing access to powerful cards like Demonic Tutor and Time Walk.

The deck focuses on assembling the combination of Coveted Jewel, The One Ring, and Paradoxical Outcome to generate a large amount of mana and draw cards. It utilizes artifact ramp like Mishra's Workshop and Mana Crypt along with powerful artifacts like Mana Vault and Grim Monolith to accelerate its mana production. The deck also includes counterspells like Force of Will to protect its combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With cards like Tinker and Karn, the Great Creator to search for key artifacts, the deck aims to win quickly through a strong combo finish.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage and controlling the board. It utilizes powerful cards like Force of Will, Ancestral Recall, and Lurrus of the Dream-Den to control the game. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and counterspells like Spell Pierce to maintain control. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm help with card selection and filtering, ensuring the deck can react to any situation effectively. Overall, this deck aims to dominate the game by controlling the opponent's plays and resources.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing the Oath of Druids card to cheat out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Bolas's Citadel onto the battlefield. The deck also includes a mix of control elements like counter spells and disruption, along with card draw and tutoring effects to help find key pieces. The goal is to establish control of the game while quickly ramping into powerful threats that can close out the game efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Show and Tell and Tinker provide additional avenues for bringing out game-winning threats.

The essential concept of this deck is centered around utilizing the card "Oath of Druids" as a means of controlling the game, by quickly bringing out powerful creatures such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Oko, Thief of Crowns. The deck is designed to disrupt opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and disrupt their mana base with cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine. Additionally, the deck includes powerful tutor spells like Demonic Tutor and Vampiric Tutor to search for key cards and maintain card advantage with cantrips like Brainstorm and Impulse.

The deck focuses on using powerful control cards, primarily through countering spells and disrupting the opponent's game plan. It utilizes a combination of permanent removal, card draw, and mana acceleration to control the game. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and recursion for the deck. With key cards like Force of Will, Ancestral Recall, and Time Walk, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while maintaining control of the game. The deck also features strong mana denial with cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine.

This deck focuses on using cards like Ancestral Recall, Dig Through Time, and Lórien Revealed to draw cards and control the game. It includes powerful artifacts like Black Lotus and the Moxes to ramp up mana quickly. Wasteland and Strip Mine are used to disrupt opponents' lands, while cards like Fatal Push and Force of Will provide removal and protection. The deck also utilizes the Companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den for additional value. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficient control and card advantage to outlast opponents in a one-on-one match-up.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive artifacts while using mana denial cards like Strip Mine and Wasteland to control the pace of the game. The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Sphere of Resistance and Trinisphere to slow down the opponent's spells, while deploying threats like Lodestone Golem and Nettlecyst to quickly finish the game. The inclusion of Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Inventors' Fair provide additional versatility and card advantage, making it a potent Aggro-MUD deck in the Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with key cards like Ichorid, Stinkweed Imp, and Golgari Grave-Troll to trigger powerful combos such as Bridge from Below and Prized Amalgam. Using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Cabal Therapy to manipulate the graveyard and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, using Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect key pieces and maintain control of the game. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful graveyard-based combo strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to play aggressive Hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria to disrupt the opponent's game plan while also using mana denial cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine to control the board. The deck aims to slow down the opponent's plays with taxing effects like Chancellor of the Annex and Trinisphere while also maintaining pressure with efficient creatures like White Plume Adventurer and Dauntless Dismantler. Additionally, the deck includes powerful hate cards like Karakas to further disrupt the opponent's strategies and create a strong board presence.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on utilizing the power of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion to constantly bring back valuable cards from the graveyard. The deck aims to control the game through counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, removal spells like Fatal Push, and disruptive cards like Wasteland and Demonic Tutor. The key win condition revolves around assembling the Time Vault and Voltaic Key combo for infinite turns, while also utilizing powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Dig Through Time to maintain card advantage.

The deck focuses on using cards like Bazaar of Bagdad and Serum Powder to quickly fill the graveyard with Dredge creatures, which can then be sacrificed for value with Bridge from Below. By using Cabal Therapy and Noxious Revival to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also gaining advantage with cards like Ichorid and Narcomoeba, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combo of powerful creatures like Prized Amalgam and Hollow One. Force of Will and Force of Negation provide protection against disruption, making it a fast and resilient combo deck.
